mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bookings ( id, shipper_id, cargo_type, cargo_weight_kg, cargo_length_cm, cargo_width_cm, cargo_height_cm, cargo_quantity, cargo_description, cargo_un_number, cargo_hazard_class, cargo_min_temp_celsius, cargo_max_temp_celsius, origin_location, destination_location, requested_pickup_date, requested_delivery_date, status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{row.id}, #{row.shipperId}, #{row.cargoType}, #{row.cargoWeightKg}, #{row.cargoLengthCm}, #{row.cargoWidthCm}, #{row.cargoHeightCm}, #{row.cargoQuantity}, #{row.cargoDescription}, #{row.cargoUnNumber}, #{row.cargoHazardClass}, #{row.cargoMinTempCelsius}, #{row.cargoMaxTempCelsius}, #{row.originLocation}, #{row.destinationLocation}, #{row.requestedPickupDate}, #{row.requestedDeliveryDate}, #{row.status}, #{row.createdAt}, #{row.updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, shipper_id, cargo_type, cargo_weight_kg, cargo_length_cm, cargo_width_cm, cargo_height_cm, cargo_quantity, cargo_description, cargo_un_number, cargo_hazard_class, cargo_min_temp_celsius, cargo_max_temp_celsius, origin_location, destination_location, requested_pickup_date, requested_delivery_date, status, created_at, updated_at FROM bookings WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, shipper_id, cargo_type, cargo_weight_kg, cargo_length_cm, cargo_width_cm, cargo_height_cm, cargo_quantity, cargo_description, cargo_un_number, cargo_hazard_class, cargo_min_temp_celsius, cargo_max_temp_celsius, origin_location, destination_location, requested_pickup_date, requested_delivery_date, status, created_at, updated_at FROM bookings ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
